current_milestone.title: Expressive Capability
current_milestone.active_objective: Establish whether the current Existing Show has a provenance-safe, Show-bound Color action resource that can be evaluated as a second bounded expressive mechanism.

next_acceptance_gate.why_it_matters: M2 has one safely proven typed mechanism (experimental density). The smallest evidence gap before evaluating another expressive mechanism is whether a current-Show Color preset/action resource can be bound, applied, and validated without name-based or artistic inference.
dependencies: current Show Preset inventory and applicability evidence
next_acceptance_gate.next_review_condition: A bounded read-only verification reports SHOW_BOUND_VERIFIED, PARTIAL, or UNSUPPORTED Color action applicability. It must not select a palette, assign a Group role, or alter a plan.

human_review_decisions.limitations: No numeric-ID tie-break, equal Group level, cohort saturation, Group participation count, or dimmer level may be promoted into Lighting Design knowledge or a production strategy.

backlog.why_it_matters: Broadens conditional professional design knowledge beyond individual cases.
backlog.next_review_condition: New bounded, source-diverse pack or a real reasoning gap.

backlog.why_it_matters: Separates verified capability and case visual affordance from fixed fixture roles.
backlog.next_review_condition: A real case requires visual selection beyond density-only composition.

backlog.why_it_matters: Color can become a second expressive mechanism only after a Show-bound preset/action applicability verification; it does not follow from channel COLOR capability alone.
backlog.next_review_condition: SHOW_BOUND_COLOR_PRESET_APPLICABILITY_VERIFICATION_001 closes with a bounded evidence result.

backlog.why_it_matters: Requires safe typed action grammar and does not follow merely from mover capability.
backlog.next_review_condition: A verified native action path and a specific design-intent use case exist.

backlog.why_it_matters: Timing/strobe behavior needs verification and must not follow Group labels.
backlog.next_review_condition: Safe behavior/applicability evidence exists for a bounded case.

backlog.why_it_matters: Performer/area focus needs semantic targets and geometry, not Pan/Tilt capability alone.
Current vocabulary must not force aerial/beam potential into an inaccurate role.
backlog.next_review_condition: A verified action path and real spatial case justify vocabulary work.

backlog.why_it_matters: Can resolve coverage/hierarchy only when a specific case needs it.
backlog.next_review_condition: Zen has known visual facts, a confirmed layout, or a later case cannot be reviewed truthfully without them.

backlog.why_it_matters: Tracks materially new fixture technology without making selection automatic.
backlog.next_review_condition: About 120 days after the last review or a concrete production requirement.

backlog.why_it_matters: Only flexible/large-production planning may assess an actual design gap for equipment.
backlog.next_review_condition: An explicit production planning case permits fixture selection.

backlog.why_it_matters: Production confidence requires real operator and venue evidence.
backlog.next_review_condition: A real show/venue case is available.

backlog.why_it_matters: Tests whether an operator can refine rather than rescue a generated Show.
backlog.next_review_condition: Native MA2 implementation reaches rehearsal-ready scope.

backlog.why_it_matters: Preserve separable console capability/resolution layers without starting an MA3 Builder.
Evidence and review remain the source of truth until runtime validation warrants a profile.
Verification-process tooling is intentionally separate from current product work.
